questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The assignment was _________ early in the morning.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The assignment was _________ early in the morning.
questions.solution: 'Due' will be used because it means expected or scheduled to happen at a particular time. The sentence mentions that the assignment was to be completed early in the morning, making 'due' correct here. Whereas, 'Dew' means moisture on the ground, 'Doe' means a female deer, and 'Do' means to perform an action, which do not fit in this context. "Due" is an adjective describing when the assignment was expected. The other options are either nouns (dew, doe) or a verb (do), which do not fit grammatically in this sentence structure

questions.question: Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. Select 'no article' if no article is required. The doctor asked the patient to have _____ MRI scan of his brain.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. Select 'no article' if no article is required.

The doctor asked the patient to have _____ MRI scan of his brain.
questions.solution: 'An' is the correct article because the pronunciation of 'MRI' starts with a vowel sound ('em'), making 'an' appropriate. Whereas: 'A' is used before words that start with a consonant sound, which doesn't apply here. 'No article' is used when the noun is indefinite or general, but that's not the case here as 'MRI scan' refers to a specific test. 'The' is used for definite nouns. Since 'MRI scan' is mentioned for the first time here, 'the' is inappropriate.
